name: Remote Contact
summary: A Thunder Bluff resident needs news of a delivery from Jediga in Azshara. You are asked to find her camp and ask when it will arrive.

sections.title: Word from Azshara
sections.body: A resident of Thunder Bluff is waiting on reagents sent by Jediga, an orc in Azshara. Since the resident is needed in Thunder Bluff, you are asked to find Jediga's camp and ask when the delivery is expected.

faq.q: Who is waiting for the delivery?
faq.answer: A resident of Thunder Bluff is waiting for reagents from Jediga in Azshara.
Jediga is an orc in Azshara who is expected to send reagents to a resident of Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What am I asked to ask Jediga?
faq.answer: You are asked to inquire when the delivery to Thunder Bluff can be expected.
